blocks.title: A shape is forgotten
blocks.source:
Variant Forma
  Case Circulo(radio As Integer)
  Case Punto
EndVariant
Algorithm Incompleto
  Define f As Forma <- Forma.Punto;
  Switch f Do
    Forma.Circulo(r): Write r;
  EndSwitch
EndAlgorithm

entries.text: A variant needs at least one alternative.
Alternative names are unique within the variant, and field names within each alternative.
A variant is a value: it is copied like a record.
